abilities.name: Covalent Link
abilities.description: Every 4 s, an orbit hit arcs to 1 more nearby enemy, like a shared bond.
abilities.visual_cue: Thin cyan bond line between two enemies
abilities.chemistry_basis: Nonmetals share electrons in covalent bonds

abilities.name: Full Shell
abilities.description: Drop below 30% HP and your full shell blocks contact damage for 2 s.
abilities.visual_cue: Neon ring flashes around the core
abilities.chemistry_basis: A full outer shell makes noble gases unreactive

abilities.name: Violent Reaction
abilities.description: Every 6 s, your next thrown electron hits 30% harder.
abilities.visual_cue: Orange flare trail on the thrown electron
abilities.chemistry_basis: One loose outer electron makes alkali metals react violently

abilities.name: Mineral Mend
abilities.description: Grabbing an energy orb restores 5 HP, at most once every 8 s.
abilities.chemistry_basis: Calcium and magnesium are building blocks of bone and minerals

abilities.name: Semiconductor
abilities.description: Pull in orbs and loose electrons from 20% farther away.
abilities.visual_cue: Faint crystal grid around the core
abilities.chemistry_basis: Metalloids conduct partway, like silicon in chips

abilities.name: Electron Hunger
abilities.description: Enemies you destroy drop 25% more energy.
abilities.visual_cue: Green swirl sucks the orb toward you
abilities.chemistry_basis: Halogens are one electron short and grab them eagerly

abilities.name: Malleable Guard
abilities.description: Once every 25 s, dropping below 30% HP restores 15 HP.
abilities.visual_cue: Core dents, then pops back into shape
abilities.chemistry_basis: Soft metals like tin and lead bend instead of breaking

abilities.name: Catalyst
abilities.description: Your electrons orbit 15% faster, sweeping enemies more often.
abilities.visual_cue: Warm metallic shimmer on each orbit
abilities.chemistry_basis: Transition metals speed up reactions as catalysts

abilities.name: Magnetic Field
abilities.description: Every 5 s, an orbit hit slows that enemy to 70% speed for a moment.
abilities.visual_cue: Teal field lines wrap the enemy
abilities.chemistry_basis: Rare earths like neodymium make the strongest magnets

abilities.name: Half-Life
abilities.description: Every 10 s, a destroyed enemy releases radiation that hits 2 nearby enemies.
abilities.visual_cue: Bright green burst with a dark outline
abilities.chemistry_basis: Actinides are radioactive and release energy as they decay

abilities.name: Island of Stability
abilities.description: Properties unknown, momentum isn't: you move 10% faster.
abilities.chemistry_basis: Superheavy atoms may sit near a predicted island of stability
